tests.procedure: Weigh 100 mg sample in a stoppered tube; add 0.1 mL solvent, shake 1 min, hold at 25.0 ± 0.5 °C for 15 min, repeat shake/hold once if not dissolved; stepwise add 0.9 mL, 2 mL, 7 mL solvent (same shake and hold) to classify very soluble / freely soluble / soluble / sparingly soluble; if still undissolved use 10 mg in 10 mL (slightly soluble) then 1 mg in 10 mL (very slightly soluble), else practically insoluble.
tests.source: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)100 IUmg__STM Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)100 IUmg) without micro.txt:29

tests.procedure: Identification by HPLC: prepare the chromatographic conditions and reference solution for the assay; prepare the sample solution by the assay sample preparation; run and analyse; the retention time of the principal peak of the test corresponds to that of the standard chromatogram.
tests.source: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)100 IUmg__STM Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)100 IUmg) without micro.txt:30

tests.procedure: Loss on drying (BP Appendix IX D): weigh empty weighing bottle previously dried at 105 °C and cooled in desiccator (W0); weigh 1.000 g sample (W1); dry in calibrated oven at 105 °C for 2 h, cool in desiccator, weigh (W2); repeat to constant weight. % LOD = (W1 - W2) / (W1 - W0) x 100.

tests.procedure: Identity for tocopherol: 50 mg sample in 10 mL dehydrated alcohol; add with swirling 2 mL nitric acid; heat at about 75 °C for 15 min. No bright red or orange colour develops.
tests.source: Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)100 IUmg__STM Vitamin D3 (Cholecalciferol)100 IUmg) without micro.txt:32

tests.procedure: Assay (HPLC). Standard: 20 mg Vitamin D3 (500 IU/mg) working standard in 100 mL, about 20 mL water, shake 1 min, sonicate 10 min, make to volume with methanol, sonicate 5 min; take 5 mL to 100 mL with methanol; filter if necessary. Sample: 20 mg in 100 mL as for the standard; take 25 mL to 100 mL with methanol; filter if necessary. Column 5 µm, 150 x 4.6 mm, BDS C18; mobile phase 96% methanol; 1.5 mL/min; 265 nm; 30-35 °C; 100 µL; run time 8 min. Assay % = (PAt / PAst) x (Act.Wt.std / Theo.Wt.std) x (Theo.Wt.test / Act.Wt.test) x (100 / (100 - LOD)) x Potency.

details.standardPrep: 20 mg working standard (Vitamin D3 500 IU/mg) in 100 mL; 5 mL to 100 mL
details.samplePrep: 20 mg in 100 mL; 25 mL to 100 mL
details.formula: Assay % = (PAt / PAst) x (Act.Wt.std / Theo.Wt.std) x (Theo.Wt.test / Act.Wt.test) x (100 / (100 - LOD)) x Potency
details.potency: assay of working standard (value not stated in the STM)
